query: UPDATE bookings b SET status = 'no_show', no_show_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.starts_at < now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches fb JOIN organizations fo ON fo.id = fb.org_id WHERE fb.id = b.branch_id AND fo.plan = 'free') AND COALESCE(b.starts_at + make_interval(mins => (SELECT s.auto_no_show_minutes FROM branch_booking_settings s WHERE s.branch_id = b.branch_id)), b.ends_at) < now() RETURNING b.id
